6798-7084-8347.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2026-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

619-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
619-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Dormant Volcano
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2012-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2012-2034-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

891-2511-3055.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-4885-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

1692-6441-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3480-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

856-4050-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-4050-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-4050-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1365-3263-4853-6798--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-6798--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2511-4215-6730.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

411-4103-4613-6461.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-4103-4613-6461.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

2640-3558-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {W}.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-3533-4658.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Soul of Eternity and gain life equal to its toughness.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

710-5147-5617.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1785-2178-4484.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1785-2178-4484.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Ebondeath dies, triggering Soldevi Adnate, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1436-4832-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ensoul Artifact is attached to Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-4832-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-4832-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat

864-933-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

922-1656-3121-3866-4283.notablePrerequisites:
At least two additional creatures on the battlefield under your control.
You have at least one additional devotion to black that isn't from a creature you will need to sacrifice.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
922-1656-3121-3866-4283.description:
Tap Necrotic Ooze using Whisper, Blood Liturgist's ability to sacrifice two creatures and return Abhorrent Overlord to battlefield.
Abhorrent Overlord's ETB triggers, creating at least 5 creature tokens.
Using Altar Golem's ability, tap Abhorrent Overlord and 4 tokens to untap Necrotic Ooze.
Tap Necrotic Ooze and sacrifice Abhorrent Overlord and a tapped token to Whisper's ability to return Marionetter Master to the battlefield, creating 3 Servo tokens.
Tap Marionette Master and the 4 untapped tokens to untap Necrotic Ooze.
Sacrifice Marionetter Master and a Servo token, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and reanimating Abhorrent Overlord.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite life loss.
